items.title: Envirem Organics- Miramichi, New Brunswick
items.author: ACOACanada
items.content:
<article>Looking to do some fall gardening before the winter comes?

Envirem Organics develops sustainable growing products for your garden.  Envirem Organics produces what you need, while driving innovation and economic growth. ACOA is happy to support businesses like Envirem to create conditions for greater productivity and long-term economic growth.  


#NewBrunswick #Miramichi #AtlanticCanada #garden #EconomicDevelopment

Transcript
Envirem Organics develops sustainable growing products for gardeners, growers and agricultural customers
By diverting organic materials from landfills, Envirem helps reduce carbon emissions and creates beneficial products that support sustainable agriculture
ACOA has helped Envirem strengthen its operations and respond to market opportunities.

Voice of Bob Kiely, President and GM of Envirem Organics: “ACOA has been a great partner over the years. ACOA has helped us in our product development. ACOA has helped us in our capital expansions, to have four fully automatic robotic packaging lines, to be one of the largest organic producers in Eastern Canada. So, we are now a high-quality low-cost operator in Miramichi, New Brunswick.”</article>

items.title: 🎭💙 Le Pays de la Sagouine – Bouctouche, New Brunswick
items.author: ACOACanada
items.content:
<article>Experience the history of the Acadian culture at Le Pays de la Sagouine, a New Brunswick destination where the culture comes into live through music, theatre and immersive experiences.

ACOA is proud to support projects that help preserve and showcase our region’s rich culture. Through upgrades to its infrastructure, Le Pays de la Sagouine will enhance sustainability, improve their tourism experience, and continue sharing Acadian stories with visitors from near and far. 🎭

#GC

Transcription
Every year, close to 100,000 thousand visitors experience the magic of Le Pays de la Sagouine. 

With ACOA’s support, Le Pays de la Sagouine was able to sound proof a portion of the Viola-Léger Restaurant-Theatre,
improve their welcome building by adding solar panels,
and make the washrooms at Akadi Lumina accessible.

ACOA also helped with the marketing and promotion for Akadi Lumina, which just welcomed their 140,000th visitor.



Thanks to ACOA's funding,
Le Pays de la Sagouine is able to continue to improve
the client experience and to work towards our vision for the future.</article>

items.title: Atlantic Canada’s Aerospace & Defence Capabilities: Building a Stronger Future
items.author: ACOACanada
items.content:
<article>Atlantic Canada is ready. 
 
Ready to innovate. Ready to collaborate. Ready to help deliver the largest investment in Canadian defence and security in a generation. 
 
The opportunities are here—and so are the people, expertise, and industry to make them happen. 
👉 https://ow.ly/v1j250Zp4qc

Transcript
The world is changing rapidly.
Less certain, less stable.
That's why Canada has launched its first defence industrial strategy.
To protect our sovereignty, security and prosperity while supporting Canadian workers innovation and long term economic growth.
The strategy puts Canadian builders first, creating jobs and greater stability.
ACOA is supporting Atlantic Canadian businesses through advocacy and action with programs like the Regional Defence Investment Initiative.
Turning regional strength into global opportunity.
Companies across Atlantic Canada are scaling up, creating jobs, expanding capacity, advancing innovation and delivering for Canada and our allies. From engineering and advanced manufacturing to skilled trades and digital innovation, ACOA investments are helping people and communities.
Serious investments at home.
A stronger defence sector.
Keeping Canada and our allies safe.</article>

items.title: Anne of Green Gables Chocolates - Charlottetown, PEI
items.author: ACOACanada
items.content:
<article>Anne of Green Gables Chocolates credits its success to quality local ingredients, modern innovation, and a pinch of Anne Shirley’s creative charm. ACOA is proud to support the P.E.I business as they continue to grow.


Transcript
📍 Prince Edward Island
ANNE OF GREEN GABLES CHOCOLATES
The best stories begin in Avonlea!
Anne of Green Gables Chocolates began handcrafting sweets there in 1999...
...and they’ve been adding new chapters ever since.

Their most famous innovation?
Chocolate-covered potato chips, known whimsically as COW Chips

Modernized production lines have been key to meeting growing demand.
Visitors can catch a glimpse of the action at the flagship Milky Way location!

Behind the scenes, inventory is managed efficiently through integrated data systems.
Distributing decadent treats to
📍5 Island locations
📍major Canadian retail partners
📍 a booming online storefront!

So, what’s the recipe for success?
✅Local ingredients
✅Modern innovation 
✅Uncompromised quality

ACOA is proud to support Anne of Green Gables Chocolates as they continue to grow!</article>
